question: How many orders did the customer Nova Motors SA place?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Nova Motors SA'

question: How many Docking Stations were sold in completed orders?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(l.quantity) AS units FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Docking Station' AND o.status = 'completed'

question: How many returns were due to late delivery?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS returns FROM sales.returns WHERE reason = 'late_delivery'

question: How many returns had the reason wrong item?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS returns FROM sales.returns WHERE reason = 'wrong_item'

question: How many SMB customers are in Japan?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM sales.customers c JOIN sales.countries n ON n.country_code = c.country_code WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND n.name = 'Japan'

question: How many small and medium business customers are there?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM sales.customers WHERE segment = 'SMB'

question: How many orders did the sales rep Sam Okafor handle?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.sales_reps r ON r.rep_id = o.rep_id WHERE r.name = 'Sam Okafor'

question: How many orders placed in 2025 were not cancelled?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How many customers are not in the Enterprise segment?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM sales.customers WHERE segment <> 'Enterprise'

question: What was the revenue from Edge Servers in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Edge Server' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How many customers are in the UAE?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM sales.customers c JOIN sales.countries n ON n.country_code = c.country_code WHERE n.name = 'United Arab Emirates'

question: How many orders came from customers in Brazil?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.countries n ON n.country_code = c.country_code WHERE n.name = 'Brazil'

question: How many 27-inch monitors were sold in completed orders in 2024?

question: How many pending orders does Atlas Analytics SA have?

question: How many units of Support Plan Premium were sold in completed orders in 2024?

question: Which APAC sales reps were hired in 2024? List their names.

question: How many orders were handled by sales reps based in the Americas?
